children: US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that he will have spent more than $400 million to support Republican candidates by the Nov. 3

"More than 300 Million Dollars has already been spent on Advertising, Direct and Indirect Voter Contact, Rallies, Rally Arenas, Telerallies, Get Out the Vote Programs, Election Integrity, and more," Trump wrote on Truth Social.
